<script type="6c989738d7403038ff13110d-text/javascript">
    var player = videojs('player');
player.on('ready', function() {
  document.getElementById('overlayads').style.display = 'block';
});
player.on('play', function() {
  document.getElementById('overlayads').style.display = 'none';
  for(var a=document.getElementsByTagName("iframe");a.length;)a[0].parentNode.removeChild(a[0]);
});
player.on('pause', function() {
  document.getElementById('overlayads').style.display = 'block';
});
</script>
